scoring_justification: Recompute MAE and RMSE from agent's per-sample LOOCV predictions and compare to paper-reported thresholds (MAE=0.35, RMSE=0.47) via threshold_or_better with monotonic partial credit.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper RSC Adv. 2019, Fig. 3 caption: 'mean absolute error 0.35 and root mean square error 0.47'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers; no fabrication needed.

outputs.description: LOOCV predictions for all training samples at 973 K. The checker recomputes mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean square error (RMSE) from the measured and predicted columns and scores against hidden performance thresholds.

output_contract.notes: The agent must perform a genuine leave-one-out cross-validation. The checker does not verify LOOCV compliance automatically; it trusts the predictions and recomputes the headline errors. Only 57 samples with valid OSC at 973 K are used.
